_comment: Single source of truth for /capability and the generated CV. The page imports it; scripts/generate_cv.py reads it. Edit here, not in either consumer, so the two cannot drift. Employment entries carrying `capabilitySummary` also render on /capability; the rest appear only on the CV.
name: Sid Mofya
location: San Francisco Bay Area, California, USA
currentRoles: Founder, MOTIF 54. Co-founder, CopperCloud. Strategy and Finance Lead, Kafwego Resources (Zambia). Independent adviser and facilitator.

employment.title: Founder
employment.summary: Operates at the intersection of minerals, energy and compute, upstream of capital deployment. Structures pre-bankable equity and runs independent diligence for African mining, energy and data infrastructure projects, working with family offices, development finance institutions and African corporates. Helps allocators and operators frame long-cycle decisions where physical constraints, institutional capacity and sovereignty are inseparable.
